## Wine
- Custom Wine bottle location! It is now placed in the home directory inside WoWSilicon and can be changed to any location - Added a way to open the Wine terminal and Wine configuration for the WoWSilicon Wine runtime - The open terminal action now uses a shell script to avoid hitting the maximum character limit with many environment variables - Added a winemac patch to use the input source language in HKL, improving keyboard input for non-English layouts - Added a winemac patch to ignore redundant screen parameter changes, reducing unnecessary overhead - Improved Wine process management
## Performance
- Updated libSiliconPatch with 9 new hooks for Vanilla clients (+10% FPS) - Updated libSiliconPatch for WotLK with 37 new hooks (+10% FPS) - Updated x87sidecar to 1.6.0 - Fixed a lag spike caused by rapid clicking triggering excessive Window Server refreshes
## Audio
- New Audio tab! Added an Audio tab in Settings to select preferred output and input devices - Automatic Audio switching! Audio output now automatically switches when the active device changes while the game is running. Bluetooth headphones like AirPods will switch without closing the game - Added Apple Spatial Audio support for a more open soundscape. - Added audio normalization to bring quiet sounds up and loud sounds down (for people with sensitive ears)
## Input
- Trackpads no longer have inertial scrolling and behave in a more controlled way - Added GCMouse raw input support
## Profiles and Launching
- Added server management to the Realmlist tab for a nicer way to switch servers on the same profile - Shortcuts support! You can now create a shortcut for a profile in a preferred state and launch directly without opening WoWSilicon
## Mod and Addon Manager
- Added third-party mod migration for (some) DLLs - Added more guidance to the third-party launcher installation flow - Fixed mod and addon manager directory buttons not opening
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed OptionAsAlt switch detection being broken - Fixed the debug log failing to read a game directory - Fixed an ancient bug that caused Vanilla and TBC clients to hang on exit
As always, drag WoWSilicon into your Applications directory and run:
```sh xattr -cr /Applications/WoWSilicon.app ```
Or use the updater within the app itself if you already have a previous version installed.
Supported versions: macOS 15, macOS 26, macOS 27
- Updated MTLD3D to v0.7.0 - Restored HTTPS support in the bundled Wine runtime for third-party launchers
- Fixed the bundled `rosettax87_jit` version - Removed x87 translation from helper processes, which caused issues with patching - Added permission checks to Troubleshooting

# WoWSilicon 2.5.0 is here. A new path.
We have a new name, a new launcher, and the project is once again open source.
## WoWSilicon
- You can now set up your own profiles for 1.12.1, 2.4.3, or 3.3.5a based clients. - Allows the launch of third-party launchers. - Installed addons are now renamed automatically. - Addon lists can now be exported. - Reworked the graphics settings section. - Added a realmlist tab in the options. - The launcher can now auto-update again. - Added opt-in telemetry for stats tracking. - Added a force quit button.
## CrossOver
- Ships with a custom `ntdll.so` which includes the Tahoe patch and `rosetta_x87_path` environment variable. - Dropped CrossOver 25 support.
## New Game Patching Method
- All game versions are sharing the same patching method, which no longer modifies the game binary. - Game validation will work properly again. - Ascension can now be launched.
## libSiliconPatch for WrathSilicon
- Added 100 new function hooks which accelerate 3D performance. - Overall, it delivers around 2x more FPS in crowded areas.
## d9vk
- Fixed a pipeline issue which caused cursor flickering.
## rosettax87_JIT
- Updated to the latest version. - macOS 26.5 can be used.
Delete your old `TurtleSilicon.app` and replace it with this one.
As always, drag it into your Applications directory and run:
```sh xattr -cr /Applications/WoWSilicon.app ```
Supported versions: macOS 15, macOS 26
